title: pvSphere
body:
## pvSphere

Creates a polygonal sphere (or a section of one) with point normals: radius Radius around Center, tessellated by ThetaResolution longitude and PhiResolution latitude divisions. StartTheta/EndTheta (around z, 0 to 360 degrees) and StartPhi/EndPhi (from +z at 0 to -z at 180 degrees) cut out partial spheres. Use it as reference geometry or a probe surface; the curated sphere operation offers Schemaxis defaults.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- ParaView's default resolution (8 × 8) is coarse; raise both resolutions for smooth rendering or accurate probing.
- Schemaxis generates this source from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for it, so inspect the output before relying on it.

Native constructor: `Sphere`. Identity: `sources/SphereSource`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Center` | This property specifies the 3D coordinates for the center of the sphere. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `EndPhi` | The value of this property can be adjusted to form only a portion of a sphere. The value is measured in degrees. | `{"maximum":180.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `EndTheta` | The value of this property can be adjusted to form only a portion of a sphere. This value is measured in degrees. | `{"maximum":360.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `PhiResolution` | The value of this property represents the number of divisions between Start Phi and End Phi on the sphere. (See the Start Phi and End Phi properties.) The phi divisions are similar to latitude lines on the earth. | `{"minimum":3,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `3` |
| `Radius` | This property specifies the radius of the sphere. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `StartPhi` | To form a complete sphere, the value of this property should be 0 degrees, and the value of the End Phi property should be 180 degrees. The value of this property can be adjusted to form only a portion of a sphere. Set the starting angle (in degrees) in the latitudinal direction. | `{"maximum":180.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `StartTheta` | To form a complete sphere, the value of this property should be 0 degrees, and the value of the End Theta property should be 360 degrees. The value of this property can be adjusted to form only a portion of a sphere. | `{"maximum":360.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `ThetaResolution` | The value of this property represents the number of divisions between Start Theta and End Theta around the sphere. (See the Start Theta and End Theta properties.) The theta divisions are similar to longitude lines on the earth. The higher the resolution, the closer the approximation will come to a sphere, and the more polygons there will be. | `{"minimum":3,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `3` |
